title: A core charge added to an untracked part gives it an untracked core
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919); the Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' and 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' and can see costs and prices.
  • Parts → Inventory is open on the Active tab at {Location-A}.
  • Bin {Bin-A} is the default bin of {Location-A} (for example General Storage), the bin New Inventory Part fills in.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-NEWCORE-01, described {Description-A}, for example ZZAUTOTEST PL NEW CORE UNTRACKED) is active and untracked at {Location-A}, with 2 in {Bin-A} and no Core Charge, so it has no core yet.
  • The new global search (Search in the top bar) is on, as it is by default for every account.
custom_steps:
1. Search the part number of {Part-A} in Inventory and click its row.
  2. Type 30.00 in Core Charge.
  3. Click Save.
  4. Read the {Part-A} row's Core column.
  5. Click Search in the top bar and type Core for {Description-A}.
  6. Read the core's result.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: The dialog closes and the part is saved.
  • Step 4: The Core column of {Part-A} reads $30.00, and its Total Qty still reads "Not Tracked".
  • Steps 5 and 6: If global search lists no "Core for {Description-A}" result, the core's tracking cannot be seen on any screen: this part cannot be checked by hand; write "not checked by hand" in the result comment.
  • Step 6: The "Core for {Description-A}" result shows "Not Tracked" in place of an available badge: the new core took {Part-A}'s untracked state.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10818 (Story 5, Change Tracking on an Existing Part); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S5-R9 and S9-R20 (how global search shows an untracked part), read 14 Oct 2026. Design: no board shows a core. Where cores show: QA lead's answer of 9 Oct 2026, situation 5. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S5-R9: “The part's core is tracked or untracked together with the part, in the same save. A core added to the part later, or in the same save, takes the part's tracking state.”
  • S9-R20: “Global search shows "Not Tracked" for an untracked part, in place of its "{n} available" badge.”
